install: /home/anacan-runner/run-sql.py on anacan-gcp-candidate after 20261117090000_shop_partners.sql; enrolls shop_partner_clicks and shop_partner_orders in guarded_relations with the three standard triggers (the migration refuses without the guard catalog or shop_partners and verifies 2 relations / 6 triggers and that the conversion RPC is not executable by anon/authenticated)
preserve: shop_partners keeps its CDC/writer guard and every existing column; five columns are added (tracking_key, tracking_secret_hash, tracking_secret_set_at, attribution_days default 30, tracking_coupons default '{}') and every partner gets a public tracking key
the raw server secret is never stored: only its sha256; it is returned once to the owner
orders without an Anacan click (inside the attribution window, same partner) or an Anacan coupon are not stored

relations.note: + tracking_key (public pk_…), tracking_secret_hash (sha256 hex), tracking_secret_set_at, attribution_days, tracking_coupons
one row per outbound click to a partner site: random token from the device, partner, product, user, placement, internal flag
attributed partner orders: external order id, click or coupon, amount, currency, line items (sku, name, quantity, price), status, commission %, source pixel|server|manual, verified, test

functions: shop_partner_conversion_v1(text, text, text, jsonb) (service_role only; called by the partner-conversion edge function)
edge_functions: partner-conversion: public POST/OPTIONS route, no JWT; needs SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in its catalog.mjs entry and a line in ENABLED_FUNCTIONS
tests: supabase/tests/shop_partner_tracking.sql (transaction, rolled back; prints PARTNER_TRACKING_OK) and src/lib/partner-tracking.test.ts
